title: Park your work

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: You're in the middle of a messy edit when a critical bug comes in. Stash your work to park it.

hints: You are in the middle of something but need to switch tasks.
`git stash` saves your uncommitted changes and cleans the folder.
Type `git stash` to park your work. Use `git stash pop` to get it back.
recap: git stash parks your uncommitted changes so you can switch tasks.
